description:
You are acting as an artifact manager who is curating binary repositories. Please use the SQLite CLI to create a new SQLite database at /home/user/artifacts.db. Inside this database, create a table called binaries with the following schema:

- id (INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY, AUTOINCREMENT)
- name (TEXT, NOT NULL)
- version (TEXT, NOT NULL)
- sha256 (TEXT, NOT NULL)

After creating the table, insert a single record into the binaries table with these values:

- name: "libfoo"
- version: "1.2.3"
- sha256: "a54d88e06612d820bc3be72877c74f257b561b19d6e5b5a5b1e02f3f3ab8b511"

Finally, produce a report of all data in the binaries table by querying the table. Save the output of the query in a file called /home/user/binaries_report.txt.

The contents of /home/user/binaries_report.txt must meet these requirements so automated verification can check your work:

- The file must contain the output from the SQLite CLI command: SELECT * FROM binaries;
- The output should be exactly as returned by the SQLite command line, including column headers (id|name|version|sha256) and the single row entry, separated by the default pipe ('|') delimiter, with newlines in between.

Example format (column headers on one line, data on the next line):

id|name|version|sha256
1|libfoo|1.2.3|a54d88e06612d820bc3be72877c74f257b561b19d6e5b5a5b1e02f3f3ab8b511

Remember that both the database and the report file must be created in /home/user.
